name: @kargonomi/workspace
description: Kargonomi API için ASP.NET, Node.js, PHP, Python ve Electron masaüstü entegrasyon çalışma alanı.
author: Hamza Deniz Yılmaz ve Beyza Gül

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix NodeJS && npm --prefix NodeJS run build && npm ci --prefix "ElectronJS - Deskop"
scripts.postman:check: node -e "for (const f of require('node:fs').readdirSync('Postman').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json'))) JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('Postman/'+f,'utf8')); console.log('Postman JSON valid')"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix NodeJS run lint && npm --prefix "ElectronJS - Deskop" run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix NodeJS run typecheck && npm --prefix NodeJS run build && npm --prefix "ElectronJS - Deskop" run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix NodeJS run build && npm --prefix "ElectronJS - Deskop" run build
scripts.verify: npm run openapi:check && npm run postman:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
